reason: A web-based utility for graphically managing DSH plugins, including enablement, grouping, installation, updates, removal, health inspection, marketplace search, and dependency visualization.

summaries.zh: 通过 Web 界面统一管理 DSH 插件，支持启停、分组、安装、更新、卸载、健康状态查看和依赖关系可视化。
summaries.en: A web interface for managing DSH plugins with controls for enabling, grouping, installing, updating, uninstalling, health inspection, and dependency visualization.

capabilities: Manages plugin enablement by editing profile configuration
Installs, updates, and uninstalls plugins through package commands
Queries GitHub plugin repositories and package registry metadata
Displays plugin health, details, and dependency relationships in a web UI
Persists catalog, grouping, and description data in user configuration files
